basic_info.description: Welcome to this beautifully renovated corner residence at Broderick Place, where natural light pours in from multiple exposures, and modern design meets everyday comfort. This 2 bed, 2 bath condo offers a thoughtful floor plan, luxury finishes, and a private terrace - perfect for indoor-outdoor living. Step inside to wide-plank white oak floors, custom window treatments, and elegant finishes throughout. The open-concept living/dining areas flow seamlessly together, creating an inviting space for entertaining. A beautifully remodeled chef's kitchen anchors the space, featuring marble countertops, a subway tile backsplash, stainless steel appliances, counter seating, and generous storage. The primary suite is a quiet urban retreat, complete with direct access to the terrace, a spa-like en-suite bath with a walk-in shower, and a spacious walk-in closet. The second bedroom is ideally positioned on the opposite side of the unit for added privacy. The adjacent bathroom has been updated with a sleek soaking tub and glass enclosure. Completing this incredible home is in-unit laundry and 1 car pkg. Located at the intersection of multiple vibrant neighborhoods with access to Faletti's, Bi-Rite, the Panhandle, the Divisadero corridor, Alamo SQ Park, and some of the city's best restaurants.
